live_no_key.name: Yahoo Finance (unofficial)
live_no_key.return_shape: chart.result[0].meta: { regularMarketPrice, chartPreviousClose, currency, symbol, longName, regularMarketChangePercent } + chart.result[0].indicators.quote[0]
live_no_key.notes: No key. Proxy through backend (CORS + works from any IP). Symbols: SPY, QQQ, AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, META, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD. Commodities: GC=F, SI=F, CL=F, NG=F.

live_no_key.name: CoinGecko
live_no_key.return_shape: simple/price -> {id:{usd,usd_24h_change}}; coins/markets -> [{id,symbol,name,current_price,price_change_percentage_24h,market_cap,total_volume,image}]
live_no_key.notes: No key for public tier (~30 calls/min). Best source for token metadata + images.

live_no_key.name: DexScreener
live_no_key.return_shape: pairs[].{ pair, chainId, dexId, baseToken:{address,symbol,name,icon}, quoteToken, priceUsd, fdv, marketCap, liquidity:{usd}, volume:{h24}, info:{imageUrl}, url }
live_no_key.notes: No key. pairs[0].info.imageUrl = token logo. Rate limit ~300 req/min. Batch mints 30/call.

live_no_key.name: Coinbase Spot
live_no_key.return_shape: {data:{base,currency,amount}}
live_no_key.notes: No key for spot price. Good fallback when others rate-limit.

live_no_key.name: OKX Market
live_no_key.return_shape: data[0].{ instId, last, open24h, high24h, low24h, volCcy24h, ts }
live_no_key.notes: No key for public market data. Geo-friendly where Binance is blocked.

live_no_key.name: open.er-api (ExchangeRate)
live_no_key.return_shape: rates: { EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, ... } (all 160 currencies vs base), time_last_update_unix
live_no_key.notes: No key, free, unlimited for daily rates. Refresh ~1/day.

live_no_key.name: Open-Meteo
live_no_key.return_shape: current_weather.{temperature, windspeed, weathercode}, daily/hourly arrays
live_no_key.notes: No key, free, no rate limit enforced.

live_no_key.name: Picsum Photos
live_no_key.return_shape: raw image (redirect to fastly CDN). Deterministic with seed.
live_no_key.notes: No key. Random placeholder images for UI/gallery. i.imageUrl source.

live_no_key.name: Google News RSS
live_no_key.return_shape: RSS XML: <item><title><link><pubDate><source>
live_no_key.notes: No key. Real news, 30min fresh. Parse with fast-xml-parser or regex.

live_no_key.name: ipapi.co
live_no_key.return_shape: {ip, city, region, country, latitude, longitude, timezone, org}
live_no_key.notes: No key for low volume; 403 from datacenter IPs — proxy through a residential-ish exit if needed. alt: ipwho.is (no key).

live_no_key.name: ipwho.is
live_no_key.return_shape: {ip, success, city, country, latitude, longitude, timezone, connection:{isp}}
live_no_key.notes: No key. Unblocked fallback for ipapi.

live_no_key.name: CoinPaprika
live_no_key.return_shape: {id, name, symbol, quotes:{USD:{price, percent_change_24h, market_cap}}, total_supply}
live_no_key.notes: No key. Aggregated prices + unique /people endpoint (founder/team bios) for research.

live_no_key.name: CoinLore
live_no_key.return_shape: [{id, symbol, name, price_usd, percent_change_24h, market_cap_usd, volume24}]
live_no_key.notes: No key. Simple, fast, generous limits. Good fallback.

live_no_key.name: GeckoTerminal (DEX)
live_no_key.return_shape: data[].{ attributes:{address, base_token:{symbol,image_url}, price_usd, fdv_usd, volume_usd:{h24}, reserve_in_usd} }
live_no_key.notes: No key. 100+ chains. DexScreener alternative with candles. Token logo in base_token.image_url.

live_no_key.name: Alternative.me Fear & Greed
live_no_key.return_shape: data[]: { value, value_classification, timestamp }
live_no_key.notes: No key. The exact source for MiroFish's existing Fear & Greed panel. History array for trend.

live_no_key.name: Kraken Public
live_no_key.return_shape: result[XBTUSD].{ a:[ask], b:[bid], c:[last], v:[volume], p:[vwap] }
live_no_key.notes: No key for public market data (spot + futures). 640+ assets.

live_no_key.notes: No key. Served as CSV. Add ?&t={tickers} to filter. Screen top gainers: f=sh_price_5to100,o=-change.
